name: Hierophant Bio-Titan
blocked_sentences: Frenzied Metabolism — As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may remove any number of +1/+1 counters from among creatures you control. This spell costs {2} less to cast for each counter removed this way

needs.what: a card-level cost_reduction shape that discounts the spell's generic mana by N for each time its optional repeatable additional_cost was paid on this cast line (Action.additional_times), e.g. {"per_additional_paid": 2} beside additional_cost {"remove_counters_from_among": {"count": 1, "counter": "+1/+1", "types": ["Creature"], "controller": "you"}} with additional_optional and additional_repeatable; legality must price each cast line with its own announced count (601.2b/601.2f) and bound the count by the +1/+1 counters available among your creatures
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The additional cost half is sayable (remove_counters_from_among with additional_optional + additional_repeatable, as squad/replicate do), but cost_reduction_keys (amount, count, total_power, greatest_mana_value, total_mana_value, greatest_count, creatures_died_this_turn, distinct_mana_values, energy_spent_this_turn) are all read off the board or turn ledgers; none reads the number of additional-cost payments. additional_paid is a value only for target counts and effects, not for the price, and a flat amount with a condition cannot scale per counter
